items.text: Not much optimism DeVonta Smith (hamstring) will play Sunday vs Rams; sidelined this week, expectation he won’t go. Rams get Puka Nacua back.
items.why: Hamstring; DNP multiple days; sources per McManus/Garafolo.
items.implication: Eagles WR depth thins; Hurts volume may shift; Nacua returns as WR1 boost for Rams.
items.opportunity: Targets/routes for Eagles secondary WRs/TEs; full role for Nacua

items.text: Saints placing RB Travis Etienne on injured reserve due to hamstring injury; will miss minimum four games.
items.why: Hamstring injury suffered/aggravated in Week 3; coach confirmed.
items.implication: Saints backfield becomes committee; Etienne out at least 4 games.

items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua expected to play Week 4 vs Eagles after missing two games (hip/groin); trending full practice.
items.why: McVay expects him; limited Wed progressing to full; good workouts.
items.implication: Elite WR1 return; Adams volume may moderate but offense upgrades.

items.text: Lamar Jackson and Zay Flowers among those upgraded to full participants Thursday for Ravens.
items.why: Upgraded on Thursday injury report after prior limitations (Flowers hamstring, Jackson back).
items.implication: Both expected to play full roles; Flowers high-efficiency target.
items.opportunity: Full snap/route share for Flowers; Jackson dual-threat intact

items.text: LOVE Jaylen Warren @ CLE (TNF): led all RBs with 90% snap rate last week, 20 of 22 RB touches; Dowdle out again; CLE allows 88+ rush yds every game. Top-10 play.
items.why: Workhorse usage (90% snaps, near-monopoly touches) + favorable matchup + short week but believes in him.
items.implication: Strong RB1/2 start; high floor/ceiling on volume.

items.text: LOVE Drake London @ NO: 35% target share/104 ypg career with Penix; 43.5% share (9-194) in Penix return; NO allows 5th-most WR TDs.
items.why: Elite target share with Penix back; strong historical production and matchup.

items.text: HATE Kyle Pitts @ NO: 16% target share/34 ypg career with Penix; under 8 FP in 9 of 13 such games; TE37 utilization this year.
items.why: Historically low involvement/production with Penix; poor utilization.
items.opportunity: Limited targets even with London thriving

items.text: Packers placing WR Jayden Reed on IR; will undergo season-ending neck surgery.
items.why: Neck injury; surgery confirmed by LaFleur/sources.
items.implication: GB WR depth chart opens permanently for season; Wicks/others elevate.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for remaining Packers WRs/TEs like Kraft

items.text: Kyle Pitts has six targets through three games, none inside the 10, low aDOT; among worst underperformers relative to opportunity.
items.why: Low volume, no red-zone, low aDOT despite opportunity; chart of underperformers.
items.implication: Fade until target/aDOT improve; aligns with Berry hate.

items.text: LOVE Garrett Wilson @ CHI: Mitchell likely out again; 36% target share last without him; 78% catch rate, 9.0 YPT; CHI allows 14+ YPR.
items.why: Elevated target share without Mitchell; efficient + soft secondary.
items.implication: WR2/1 upside with clear WR1 role.

items.text: HATE Justin Herbert @ SEA: pressured 44% dropbacks; SEA 4th pressure, league-low 5.0 YPA/7.7 YPC; Chargers bottom-3 implied total.
items.why: High pressure + elite pass defense matchup + low team total.

items.text: HATE Omarion Hampton @ SEA: RB27 util, 3.5% targets, 25% routes; snaps down to 42%, 13% third-down; SEA allows 2.9 YPC (2nd-fewest).
items.why: Poor utilization/role + brutal run defense matchup.

items.text: Fresh ROS rankings: Kenneth Walker #3 overall notable near top (also Parker Washington 22, Saquon 30).
items.why: Updated ROS Top 150 if season started today; factors injuries/roles/schedule.
items.implication: Elite RB1 hold/trade value; strong ROS outlook.

items.text: Justin Jefferson ankle does not sound serious; ran just two routes before injury (2-32-0) in limited action.
items.why: Injury assessment post-Week 3; limited routes data.
items.implication: Likely short-term; monitor but not long-term downgrade.
